## Services Offered by Daulx, LLC
- 24/7 AI Phone Answering: Natural-voice AI receptionist that answers every call day or night, handles common customer questions, captures leads, and routes urgent calls.
- Local SEO, Google Maps & AI Search Readiness: Technical schema markup (JSON-LD), Google Business Profile optimization, Apple Business Connect, and citation architecture for ChatGPT, Siri, Perplexity, and Google Gemini.
- High-Converting Websites: Fast, custom-engineered, mobile-first websites built to convert local searchers into phone calls and booked appointments.
- Review Generation & Management: Automated 5-star review velocity and HIPAA-aware review response workflows.
- Search & Local Ads: Paid search and local campaigns tracked directly to phone calls and booked revenue.
- Back-Office Automation: Custom software integrations, missed-call text-back, and automated reporting.
